title: Download selected agency monthly summary page to Excel
description: A customer-service user downloads the exact authorized current page selected in the agency monthly report designer as an Excel workbook. Reuse ERP-181 bounded preview and its finite field order; rerun current-user identity, customer menu grant, salesperson scope, filters and page-size checks on the export request. Preserve original currencies and status-specific amount evidence, emit numeric amount cells and formula-safe text, show an explicit empty-page note, and never imply accounting receivables or revenue recognition. OperationLogMiddleware records download access. Development only: no schema/migration edits, production SQL or real database execution, arbitrary SQL, business writes, secrets or .env changes, deployment or browser acceptance. Verify focused workbook tests and safe Release build/test.
acceptance_criteria: POST Excel export calls the same authorized bounded current-page builder as ERP-181 and rejects revoked access or invalid fields/filters before reading source data.
Workbook preserves selected field order and types, separates original currencies, keeps draft/void amounts apart from recorded totals, escapes formula-leading text and explains an empty page.

Designer offers Excel download for the current filters and page; focused tests cover denied access, pagination, empty page, mixed currencies, field order, numeric values and formula-safe labels, and safe Release build/test passes.
